propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and uses field values for drift classification, so narrowing prev to a key-set would silently degrade classification accuracy

bridge_fsck is an out-of-band consumer of prev_snapshot.json that reads the working tree directly, bypassing ctx.prev_snapshot and clone filters, so standard reconcile_once tests cannot catch regressions
Field-dependent classifications must report indeterminate status rather than inferring from empty dict entries when required field values are absent
Against key-set prev fixtures, drift classification must remain identical to full-payload fixtures for membership-only cases and report indeterminate for field-value-dependent cases
Full-payload behavior must remain byte-identical with no regressions and exit codes must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload scenarios
